Messages.Author: Nobody
Messages.Body:
Hello everyone. I'm a (relatively) new player of VTES.

My Name is Luca Ortolano and I'm from Pordenone - Italy. (Yes, I know
Stefano, the Prince of Pordenone :-) I suppose you nkow him...)

I have two simple questions about rules to submit, I hope someone can help
me..

1. I play a "Fame" on a vampire (controlled by my prey). After few turns I'm
ousted. Is the "Fame" discarded?

2. I have a vampire equipped with "Sengir Dagger". During a combat, I play
an "Immortal Grapple". Can I strike with the Sengir Dagger? Is it considered
an hand strike or not?

Thank you to everyone.

Luca Ortolano.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Nobody wrote:
>
> Hello everyone. I'm a (relatively) new player of VTES.

Howdy,

> My Name is Luca Ortolano and I'm from Pordenone - Italy. (Yes, I know
> Stefano, the Prince of Pordenone :-) I suppose you nkow him...)
>
> I have two simple questions about rules to submit, I hope someone can help
> me..
>
> 1. I play a "Fame" on a vampire (controlled by my prey). After few turns I'm
> ousted. Is the "Fame" discarded?

Yes. All cards you control are burned when you're ousted, and master cards are controlled by the player who played them (even if they're played on another player's cards).

> 2. I have a vampire equipped with "Sengir Dagger". During a combat, I play
> an "Immortal Grapple". Can I strike with the Sengir Dagger? Is it considered
> an hand strike or not?

No. Weapon strikes are not hand strikes.

Messages.Author: Gomi no Sensei
Messages.Body:
In article <YS5e9.73036$pX1.2...@news2.tin.it>,
Nobody <nob...@nemo.com> wrote:

>1. I play a "Fame" on a vampire (controlled by my prey). After few turns I'm
>ousted. Is the "Fame" discarded?

Yes. [1.3] and [1.6.2].

You control the Fame, as master cards are by default controlled by the
Methuselah playing them. Cards you control are burned when you are ousted.

>2. I have a vampire equipped with "Sengir Dagger". During a combat, I play
>an "Immortal Grapple". Can I strike with the Sengir Dagger? Is it considered
>an hand strike or not?

By [LSJ19970224], no. "Hand strike: any non-ranged, non-weapon strike that
deals damage based on the striking minion's strength, or any minion's
non-ranged damage-dealing innate strike."

>Thank you to everyone.

No problem. Always glad to see new players. By the way, all the stuff I
cited can be found in the Online Rulebook or Rulings, Errata, and Clarification
pages linked from http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes. It's a good place to look
any time you have a rules question.

gomi
